title: manage input
description: Input schema for the manage tool.

older_than_days.description: Delete flows older than this many days. Must be >= 1.

confirm.description: Confirm bulk deletion (required for older_than_days, filter axes, or delete-all).

protocol.description: Protocol filter for delete_flows; matches Stream.Protocol exactly. Mirrors query.filter.protocol.

scheme.description: Scheme filter for delete_flows — wire-observed handshake transport (http, https, tcp). For WebSocket flows use protocol="ws"; combine with scheme="https" for WS-over-TLS only. Values ws/wss are rejected as of USK-864 (per USK-848, Stream.Scheme records the handshake transport, not the application protocol). Mirrors query.filter.scheme.

http_version.description: HTTP wire-version filter for delete_flows; matches an associated flow's http_version. Empty string matches pre-USK-788 rows. Mirrors query.filter.http_version.

format.description: Export format: 'jsonl' (default) or 'har' (HTTP Archive 1.2, file output only).

filter.description: Flow filter for export_flows. Filter axes mirror the query tool.

scheme.description: Filter by Stream.Scheme — wire-observed handshake transport (http, https, tcp). For WebSocket flows use protocol="ws"; combine with scheme="https" for WS-over-TLS only. Values ws/wss are rejected as of USK-864 (per USK-848, Stream.Scheme records the handshake transport, not the application protocol). Mirrors query.filter.scheme.

http_version.description: Filter by associated flow http_version. Empty string matches pre-USK-788 rows. Mirrors query.filter.http_version.

time_after.description: Include flows after this time (RFC3339 format).

time_before.description: Include flows before this time (RFC3339 format).

include_bodies.description: Include message bodies in export (default: true).

output_path.description: File path to write export data.

input_path.description: File path to read import data.

on_conflict.description: Conflict policy for import: skip or replace (default: skip).
